title: Apply for a tradesperson certificate
summary: Find out how to apply for, or manage, a tradesperson certificate for various categories of work.
intro:
Tradesperson certificates are issued for 1, 3 or 5-years for the following categories of work:

Provisional certificates can also be issued for the following categories of work to overseas-trained applicants:

You can apply online if you've never held a tradesperson certificate. If you have a superseded qualification or are applying under mutual recognition you must apply in person.

If you already have a certificate, find out how to change, renew, restore, replace or surrender your tradesperson certificate.
who_can_apply: Be a fit and proper person to hold a tradesperson certificate.
Have the necessary knowledge, skills, qualifications, and experience for the relevant trade.
Not be a ‘disqualified person’ under the Home Building Act 1989 or another Act administered by the NSW Minister for Building.
Not be a current apprentice or trainee in the category of work you are applying for.
what_you_need: Copies of your qualifications (certificates and transcripts from the registered training organisation) in PDF, JPG, or PNG format.
For medical gasfitting categories, a completed referee statement form showing 24 months' experience.

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to apply for a tradesperson certificate.
Gather the required supporting documents as indicated on the form.
Take your documents and payment to a service centre.

faqs.q: Who can apply for a tradesperson certificate?
faqs.a: You must be aged 18 or over, be a fit and proper person, have the necessary knowledge, skills, qualifications, and experience for the relevant trade, and not be a 'disqualified person' under the Home Building Act 1989 or another Act administered by the NSW Minister for Building. You also cannot be a current apprentice or trainee in the category of work you are applying for.

faqs.q: How do I apply if I already have a certificate?
faqs.a: If you already have a certificate, you can find out how to change, renew, restore, replace, or surrender it.

faqs.q: What do I need to apply online?
faqs.a: You need a MyServiceNSW Account, copies of your qualifications (certificates and transcripts) in PDF, JPG, or PNG format, and your fee payment.
